verdict.rationale: Godot has no built-in or official mechanism for the engine/editor itself to act as an MCP client and consume external MCP servers' tools; the only MCP-related evidence is third-party community projects (godot-mcp, godot-ai) that expose Godot to external AI agents as an MCP *server*, which is the opposite direction from the story. Explicit runtime probes confirm no official Godot MCP integration exists.
